_about: Source registry for the offline NAGAN lyrics catalog. Sources listed as candidates are not automatically copied; each work must be checked individually and imported only when its redistribution status is clear.

sources.name: Project Ben-Yehuda public-domain dump
sources.content: Over 20,000 Hebrew public-domain literary works in plaintext UTF-8, with a searchable pseudocatalogue.
sources.license: Public domain, according to the repository README and LICENSE
sources.importPolicy: Import only works that are clearly song lyrics or poems suitable for singing, and retain author/title/source attribution.

sources.name: Wikisource list of songs without copyright
sources.content: A title index identifying works whose lyrics and melodies are listed as public domain; it is an index, not a complete lyrics corpus.
sources.license: Verify the individual text source and work metadata before importing
sources.importPolicy: Use as a discovery index only; locate and verify the full text and authorship before adding it to the APK.

sources.name: Project Ben-Yehuda — Hatikva collection
sources.content: Source for the currently bundled first stanza of Hatikva.
sources.license: Public domain as marked by Project Ben-Yehuda for this work

sources.name: Hebrew Songs Lyrics dataset (Shironet-derived)
sources.content: Approximately 15,000 Israeli songs scraped from Shironet.
sources.license: Dataset is labeled CC BY-SA 4.0, but underlying lyrics rights/relicensing authority are not established
sources.importPolicy: Do not bundle until permission or documented redistribution rights for the underlying lyrics are obtained.
